key_provisions_or_claims: Guidelines help determine whether a software system is an AI system under the AI Act.
The guidelines are non-binding and will be updated over time.
Published alongside the guidelines on prohibited AI practices.
AI Act rules on AI system definition, AI literacy and prohibitions have applied since 2 February 2025.
annotation.summary_en: European Commission web page announcing non-binding guidelines on the AI system definition under the EU AI Act, intended to help providers determine whether a software system is an AI system. It links to the guidelines in all EU languages and notes the first AI Act rules applied from 2 February 2025.
annotation.title_clean: Die Kommission veröffentlicht Leitlinien zur Definition von KI-Systemen, um die Anwendung der Vorschriften des ersten KI-Gesetzes zu erleichtern
annotation.title_en: The Commission publishes guidelines on AI system definition to facilitate the application of the first AI Act rules
annotation.venue: Gestaltung der digitalen Zukunft Europas (Shaping Europe's digital future)
